title: fleet-write: grant `permission-contents: write` to the mint step so the relay can arm auto-merge (`enablePullRequestAutoMerge` → "Resource not accessible by integration")
body:
③ 直派任务 — maintainer direct dispatch, filed by the director seat (summon #27, `session_0129ZpnaBcYZZ51rCvQiXg6C`). `tooling` · `domain:skills`. `.github/workflows/**` — the seat token has no workflows scope, so the PR is a draft the maintainer merges by hand; dispatched directly by this seat to the cloud dev session that built #19755.

**Provenance:** #19701's ruled shape (PR A, item 5) narrowed the App token to `issues: write`, `pull-requests: write`, `metadata: read` and said 「If the probe with `automerge_enable` is refused for permissions, add `permission-contents: write` to the mint step — deliberately not pre-granted」. Measured on the first live use: relay run 35803857677 (2026-09-23T00:51Z, request `fw-20260923T005128Z-a80e6c` on PR #19760) — action 1 `pr_ready` → HTTP 200 (the PR left draft as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`); action 2 `automerge_enable` → GraphQL `Resource not accessible by integration`; the executor stopped there as designed. Auto-merge on PR #19760 was then armed through the seat's own ccr route.

## Ruled shape — ⛔ not open for re-design
1. `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml`, the mint step (`actions/create-github-app-token@v2`): add `permission-contents: write` beside the three existing `permission-*` inputs, with a comment naming the one consumer — GitHub's `enablePullRequestAutoMerge` / `disablePullRequestAutoMerge` require it — and stating that the op table in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` has no contents op, so the grant is spent only by those two mutations.
2. `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` `PERMISSIONS`: add `contents: 'write'`; `automerge_enable` / `automerge_disable` rows spend it (`permission: 'contents'`) so the validator's permission read stays truthful; self-tests pin the two rows and the map; every existing battery green.
3. ⛔ Nothing else: no new op, no change to the sender gate, caps, ceilings, or the four write tools.
4. Landing: one draft PR, `Fixes` this card, `skip-changeset`; the maintainer merges by hand (`.github/workflows/**`); the `lint.yml` self-test rows already cover `ops.mjs`. Verification after merge: the director seat re-sends a two-action relay request (`pr_draft` + `pr_ready`, or `automerge_enable` on the next queued PR) and reads back `enabledBy` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
